about: T4, the statistical tier (scripts/parity/quality.py): every set's voices read every text, three seeds each. Texts have no digits, so the error rate does not depend on how the ASR writes numbers. reference: v1 = Mizuoto 0.1's engine workers (the reference host), upstream = the engine's upstream package (stack.py's UPSTREAM), none = no reference runs on a GPU.
